title: MuseBench: Benchmarking Intent-Level Audiovisual Arts Understanding in MLLMs
abstract: arXiv:2606.30026v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Audiovisual arts encompass diverse creative disciplines, including cinema, visual arts, stage performance, and game design, where artistic meaning arises from deliberate combinations of visual, auditory, and narrative elements (e.g., fear amplified through claustrophobic framing, or grief conveyed through silence and lingering close-ups). Artistic understanding extends beyond recognizing what is depicted to reasoning about why it is expressed through particular creative choices. Despite progress in multimodal large language models (MLLMs), reasoning about artistic intent remains underexplored, as existing benchmarks largely measure perceptual recognition. To address this gap, we introduce MuseBench, a benchmark for evaluating intent-level artistic understanding in MLLMs. It comprises 4,016 questions derived from video essays spanning cinematic arts, static visual arts, stage performing arts, and game arts. translated_title: MuseBench：面向多模态大语言模型的意图级视听艺术理解基准测试
translated_abstract: 视听艺术涵盖多样化的创作学科，包括电影、视觉艺术、舞台表演和游戏设计，其中艺术意义源于视觉、听觉和叙事元素的精心组合（例如，通过幽闭压抑的取景来放大恐惧感，或通过沉默和持续的特写镜头来传达悲伤）。艺术理解不仅限于识别所描绘的内容，更需要对为何通过特定创作选择来表达这些内容的推理能力。尽管多模态大语言模型（MLLM）已取得进展，但对艺术意图的推理仍然探索不足，因为现有基准主要衡量感知识别能力。为了填补这一空白，我们引入了MuseBench，这是一个用于评估MLLM意图级艺术理解能力的基准。它包含4,016个问题，这些问题源自涵盖电影艺术、静态视觉艺术、舞台表演艺术和游戏艺术的视频评论。
tldr: 提出MuseBench基准，通过源自视频评论的4,016个问题，首次系统评估多模态大语言模型在电影、视觉艺术、舞台表演和游戏等视听艺术中的意图级理解能力，弥补了现有基准仅测量感知识别的不足。
en_tdlr: We introduce MuseBench, a benchmark of 4,016 questions derived from video essays that systematically evaluates intent-level artistic understanding in MLLMs across cinematic, static visual, stage performing, and game arts, addressing the gap left by existing benchmarks that only measure perceptual recognition.
